1-5.title: The Tower of Babel
1-5.connection: The people sought a great name and resisted being scattered. God confused their language and scattered them. Our scaffold course explores the unfinished city; finishing our route never completes their proud tower.

memoryVerse.text: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

intro.title: A name for ourselves
intro.text: After the flood, people settled in Shinar. They wanted a city and tower to make a name for themselves and avoid being scattered. The LORD confused their language and scattered them over the earth. Their proud plan could not overrule God (Genesis 11:1–9).

intro.title: Just for our game
intro.text: Our scaffold climb and bridge are imagined. Climb the marked landings, then go down the stairs. God scattered the proud builders; climbing does not cause Him to act.

ending.message: God opposed their pride and scattered them. We depend on Him, not on making a great name for ourselves.

verse.text: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

intro.title: God calls Moses
intro.text: Moses had killed an Egyptian and fled to Midian (Exodus 2:11–15). Years later he was keeping Jethro's flock near Horeb. God had heard His people suffering in Egypt (Exodus 3:1–7).

ending.message: God gave daily bread and water to complaining people. We depend on His grace. Jesus is the bread of life.
